objective.statement: Add a second torus widget, coloured blue, to HomeView.tsx.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: HomeView renders two torus widgets: the existing green one and a new blue one (data-color blue, blue palette).
The blue widget has the distinct accessible name and visible label 'Blue Torus Widget'; the green widget stays 'Torus Widget'.
The rest of HomeView and the green widget are unchanged.

in.statement: Add a blue palette and label to TorusWidget, render a blue TorusWidget in the HomeView torus row, and add tests.

out.statement: Dependencies, widget size or shape changes, other HomeView sections, and historical workflow records.

observations.statement: TorusWidget has no blue option, so one is added following the red/green pattern, using the Tailwind blue hexes the existing tests already treat as blue (#2563eb, #60a5fa, #1e3a8a).
Label is 'Blue Torus Widget' (pattern of 'Red Torus Widget'), so the two widgets keep distinct accessible names. Placed after the green widget in the existing torus row.

provenance.source: Card text: New Feature Add a blue torus widget - Please add a second torus widget to the HomeView.tsx. Colour this one blue.
Conservative planning decision by the delivery engineer

component.rationale: Rendered output of TorusWidget and HomeView is the behaviour under change.

integration.rationale: No cross-module behaviour; the HomeView component test renders the real TorusWidget.

e2e.rationale: Static markup addition with no user flow.

increments.behavior: TorusWidget supports a blue colour, and HomeView renders a blue torus widget after the green one.
increments.doneWhen: The new TorusWidget and HomeView component tests pass and the other component tests, lint and build still pass.

tests.description: TorusWidget color=blue renders data-color blue, the blue palette hexes, and label/aria-label 'Blue Torus Widget'.
HomeView renders two torus widgets, green then blue, with distinct accessible names, both in the torus row.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: TorusWidget has no blue palette, so data-color, fills and labels do not match blue.
expectedRedEvidence.command: npx vitest run --config vitest.component.config.ts src/components/torus-widget src/views/home
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: TorusWidget color=blue: TypeError reading 'base' of undefined palette (2 failed)

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: HomeView renders only one torus widget and no 'Blue Torus Widget' region.
expectedRedEvidence.command: npx vitest run --config vitest.component.config.ts src/components/torus-widget src/views/home
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: HomeView: expected 2 widgets got 1; no region 'Blue Torus Widget'; colours ['green'] vs ['green','blue'] (3 failed)

verification.requirement: npm run test:component passes, and npm run lint and npm run build are clean
verification.result: 11 files, 58/58 tests passed; npm run lint and npm run build clean

complexity.rationale: One new palette entry and one JSX element; no state, API or dependency change.
